name: Cubical Face Decomposition Count
definition: For a finite irredundant partial cube $G$, $f_{\square}(G)$ is the number of unordered proper decompositions $G=X\oplus_IY$ whose intersection is the full cube on the shared coordinate block $I$.
normalization: The two factors are unordered; block-coordinate symmetries describing the same embedded factor pair are identified.
comments: A class is cubical-face-prime exactly when this invariant is zero.
